stories.headline: Sebi orders Avadhut Sathe, academy to refund Rs 546 crore
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has directed Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy to refund ₹546.18 crore to investors. Avadhut Sathe and his academy provided unregistered investment advisory services under the pretext of education. The regulator found that misleading testimonials were circulated while concealing overall trading losses. A penalty of ₹11.5 crore was imposed on Sathe and the academy for their actions.

stories.headline: Growth, value stocks set for reshuffle as S&P adopts new rules
stories.summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices will soon change its rules for classifying growth and value shares. The new criteria will incorporate intangible assets, forward earnings, and free cash flow instead of relying on 12-month price momentum. These changes are expected to affect approximately $375 billion of passive funds linked to the index. FTSE Russell is also considering adjustments due to the dominance of technology companies.

stories.headline: Radhakishan Damani portfolio: Top 10 stock holdings of the ace investor
stories.summary: Damani’s other top stock holdings in terms of holding value are United Breweries, TSF Investments, Horizon Industrial Parks, Blue Dart Express and Bhagiradha Chemicals.

stories.headline: Small and midcap indices post worst weekly decline in two years
stories.summary: Mid-cap and small-cap stocks in India have faced major declines, indicating a shift in market sentiment. The Nifty MidCap 150 and Small-cap 250 indices reported their worst weekly falls in two years. Domestic retail investors initially supported these segments by increasing mutual fund contributions. However, concerns over rising oil prices and fiscal deficits are adding to market uncertainties.

stories.headline: RBI’s forward dollar sales surge to record $200 billion in August
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India recorded a net purchase of $43.26 billion in August's foreign exchange market. This was done to manage significant dollar inflows from the FCNR(B) scheme and overseas borrowings. Despite the net purchase, foreign exchange reserves did not increase due to large forex sell/buy swaps. By August 31, measures attracted over $127 billion, aiding the RBI's operations.

stories.headline: Silver hits 11-month low of ₹1.95 lakh as crude stokes inflation fears
stories.summary: On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), silver futures fell ₹6,799 per kg, or 3.4%, to ₹1,92,800 per kg on Friday. Prices have plunged ₹32,955, or more than 14%, over the past 10 sessions. A recent appreciation in the rupee has provided only limited relief against the decline in international prices.

stories.headline: RBI flags rising inflation risks from West Asia conflict, El Nino despite resilient Indian economy
stories.summary: India's external sector shows resilience due to a narrowing trade gap and comfortable foreign exchange reserves. Inflationary pressures have intensified due to geopolitical tensions and supply-side bottlenecks. The RBI reported an increase in both industry and services indicators, showcasing economic strength. The IMF has revised India's growth projection for 2026-27 to 7% based on resilient domestic demand. Global financial volatility has increased amid global challenges and rising inflation risks.

stories.headline: RBI governor reiterates listing requirement for top NBFCs as focus intensifies on Tata Sons
stories.summary: India's central bank governor said on Friday non-bank finance companies classified in the upper layer are required to list on the stock market, reiterating the Reserve Bank of India's stance on the listing of Tata Sons without commenting directly on the company.

stories.headline: Sebi proposes automatic approval route for stock exchanges, depositories to ease compliance burden
stories.summary: The proposal seeks to reduce compliance requirements for market infrastructure institutions (MIIs) and improve ease of doing business. SEBI has invited public comments on the proposed framework until November 12.

stories.headline: RBI does not target any specific Rupee level, focuses on curbing volatility, says Governor Sanjay Malhotra
stories.summary: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governor Sanjay Malhotra on Friday said the central bank does not target any specific exchange rate or level for the rupee against the US dollar, stressing that its primary objective is to ensure orderly conditions in the foreign exchange market and prevent excessive volatility.

stories.headline: India's 10-year bond falls for 10th week in record slump
stories.summary: Indian government bonds have experienced their worst decline in thirty years, falling consecutively for ten weeks. Rising crude oil prices and a hawkish central bank stance have impacted the market negatively. The benchmark repo rate was recently raised to 5.5%, with further increases expected. The 2036 bond yield rose to 7.4740%, indicating a broader trend of increasing yields. These developments may significantly affect India's import bill and inflation outlook.

stories.headline: China stocks sink deeper into bear market despite state buying
stories.summary: Chinese stocks sank deeper into a bear market on Friday as state-backed rescue efforts failed to restore investor confidence, with the CSI 300 Index sliding further amid persistent momentum issues.

stories.headline: Stock Crash: Australian company shares tank 50% after flagging $7.1 million US fraud
stories.summary: Zip Co. shares fell up to 50% after disclosing A$10.1 million in fraud-related costs in the United States, prompting concerns about transparency and onboarding.

stories.headline: SEBI allows margin relief against early pay-in of securities for subsequent trades
stories.summary: SEBI announced that clearing corporations will not collect margins from trading and clearing members on clients subsequent cash segment positions up to the value of successfully accepted early pay-in

stories.headline: Nippon AMC pays ₹96.76 crore to settle SEBI case over Yes Bank bonds
stories.summary: Nippon Life India Asset Management has paid ₹96.76 crore to settle a SEBI case over mutual fund investments in Yes Bank’s AT-1 bonds. The regulator’s final settlement order is awaited.

stories.headline: Bond market volatility drags largest sovereign wealth fund to $30 billion loss
stories.summary: Norges Bank Investment Management (NBIM) manages the $2.3 trillion fund. It said accounting return for the period was at a loss of 27.8 billion kroner or $29.7 billion. About 70% of its fixed income portfolio is allocated to the government's bonds while the remaining is invested in corporate debt.

stories.headline: Amagi Media shares slip after company flags cybersecurity threat
stories.summary: Amagi Media has launched an investigation with external cybersecurity experts and legal counsel after a threat actor threatened to publish allegedly obtained operational data unless a payment was made.

stories.headline: eMudhra shares crash 20% to 52-week low after govt orders security probe
stories.summary: On the NSE, the stock tumbled 19.91% to ₹346 apiece; the scrip of the company tanked 19.63% to ₹346.85 per share on the BSE

stories.headline: HDFC Bank shares near 52-week low amid insider leak probe
stories.summary: Veteran ICICI Group executive Anup Bagchi is set to assume the role of chief executive on October 27, inheriting a bank navigating multiple leadership upheavals simultaneously

curation.newsworthiness_rule: Exclude issuer corporate announcements, commercial order/contract wins, all IPO/FPO coverage, and FII/FPI/DII-related stories; retain regulator/court directives and price-action stories with material catalysts or exceptional broad-market context.
